sources.title: Guinness World Records report, 21 March 2012
claims: A 50 kilogram chocolate egg sold for £7,000 at a London charity auction in March 2012.
It was designed by William Curley.
Seven chocolatiers worked for three days.
Fillings included muscovado caramel, Japanese black vinegar, rosemary and olive oil.
The report described a non-jewelled chocolate egg record in 2012, not a current record.
